source: The value of a message in a related locale is a good start for a translation: {0} when translating to {1}, {2} when translating to {3}. The prompt shows up to two of them under the source value:
text: 相關語系中的訊息值是很好的翻譯起點：翻譯成 {1} 時參考 {0}，翻譯成 {3} 時參考 {2}。提示會在來源值下方顯示最多兩個相關值：
